_comment: Sidecar to DESIGN.md. Machine-readable extract of tokens actually defined in src/app/globals.css @theme, plus the radius/shadow values as shipped (not as pinned in the direction contract). Source of truth is globals.css; regenerate this file if globals.css changes.

font.sans: Plus Jakarta Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

colorRoleMapping.primary: structure + primary action (headlines, active nav, primary CTA fill, focus ring)
colorRoleMapping.secondary-container: the one positive-confirmation surface (sourced tag, save/copy success pulse)
colorRoleMapping.tertiary-fixed: identity/marker accents (avatar initial, active bookmark, confidence badge, interviewer-question numbers)
colorRoleMapping.error-container: validation + request-failure states, unmodified Material role

radius._note: No --radius-* override defined in @theme; values are Tailwind's unmodified default scale. Direction contract stated 24px cards; shipped value is 16px (rounded-2xl). Build wins.

motion.entrance: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both — one-shot content settle, tiered delays 40ms/80ms/160ms
motion.pulse-once: 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) — one-shot success/attention flash to secondary-container
motion.searching: 1.3s ease-in-out infinite — the only loop, scoped to SearchingDots, unmounted on load end

spacing._note: No custom xs/sm/md/lg spacing scale defined by design; Tailwind's numeric scale (gap-3, p-6, ...) is used directly to avoid colliding with max-w-md etc.

typeRamp.name: card-title
typeRamp.usage: every Card title, sign-in panel title

iconSystem: Material Symbols Outlined webfont, .material-symbols-outlined class, sizes text-[16px] to text-[20px] inline with labels; native to the Material-3-ported world, not a generic default import.
